description: Number of individual AR invoices included in this financing transaction. Supports reconciliation between the financing batch and the underlying invoice pool, particularly relevant for agricultural commodity trading where multiple weight-ticket-backed invoices may be bundled.
reference: GAAP ASC 860-20, SAP S/4HANA FI Module

description: Total fee charged by the financing institution for the receivable financing service. Includes service fees, discount charges, and any other financing costs. Recognized as a financing cost in the income statement per GAAP ASC 860 and IFRS 9.
reference: GAAP ASC 860-20, IFRS 9, SAP S/4HANA CO Module

description: The fee rate applied to the total invoice face amount to calculate the factoring fee. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.015000 = 1.5%). May be a flat rate or tiered based on invoice age, customer credit quality, or commodity type.
reference: GAAP ASC 860, Commercial Finance Association Standards

description: Internal or industry-standard code identifying the financing institution. Used for system integration, GL posting, and counterparty reporting. May correspond to a bank identifier code (BIC/SWIFT) or internal vendor code in SAP FI.
reference: SWIFT BIC Standard, SAP S/4HANA FI Module

description: Legal name of the financial institution (bank, factor, or special purpose vehicle) to which the receivables are sold or pledged. Critical for counterparty risk management and financial statement disclosure under GAAP ASC 860 derecognition assessment.
reference: GAAP ASC 860-10-50, IFRS 7 (Financial Instruments Disclosures)

description: Externally-known unique reference number assigned to the receivable financing arrangement, used for communication with the financing institution and internal tracking. Corresponds to the facility or transaction reference in SAP FI or Oracle NetSuite AR modules.
reference: GAAP ASC 860, IFRS 9

description: Current lifecycle status of the receivable financing transaction, tracking progression from initiation through settlement. Values: draft (being prepared), submitted (sent to institution), approved (institution confirmed), active (funds disbursed), settled (fully reconciled), cancelled (voided).
reference: GAAP ASC 860, IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

description: Classification of the receivable financing arrangement. Factoring involves outright sale of AR; invoice discounting retains collection responsibility; supply chain finance is buyer-led; asset-backed lending pledges AR as collateral; forfaiting is used for medium-term trade receivables. Common in agricultural commodity trading for seasonal cash flow management.
reference: GAAP ASC 860-10, IFRS 9, FASB ASU 2022-02

description: General ledger account code used to post the receivable financing transaction in the enterprise accounting system. Typically maps to a factored receivables or short-term financing liability account per the chart of accounts in SAP S/4HANA FI or Oracle NetSuite GL.
reference: GAAP ASC 860, IFRS 9, SAP S/4HANA FI Module, Oracle NetSuite GL

description: Date on which the receivable financing transaction is posted to the general ledger. May differ from disbursement_date due to period-end cut-off requirements. Critical for accurate period-end financial reporting and SOX compliance.
reference: GAAP ASC 860, IFRS 9, SOX Section 404, SAP S/4HANA FI

description: Indicates whether the financed receivables have been removed from the agricultural enterprise balance sheet per GAAP ASC 860 or IFRS 9 derecognition criteria. True = receivables derecognized (off-balance-sheet); False = receivables remain on balance sheet (secured borrowing treatment).
reference: GAAP ASC 860-20-40, IFRS 9 3.2.3, SOX Section 404

description: Date by which the underlying customer invoices are expected to be paid and the financing arrangement is expected to be fully settled. Used for aging analysis, liquidity forecasting, and monitoring of overdue financing positions.
reference: GAAP ASC 860, IFRS 9, Commercial Finance Association Standards

description: Free-text field for additional context, special conditions, or operational notes related to the receivable financing transaction. May include details about seasonal payment terms, commodity-specific conditions, or financing institution special requirements.
reference: GAAP ASC 860, Internal SOP

description: Indicates whether the customer (invoice obligor) has been formally notified of the assignment or sale of their receivable to the financing institution. Notification is legally required in many jurisdictions for the assignment to be enforceable against the debtor. True = notification sent; False = not yet notified.
reference: UCC Article 9 (Secured Transactions), IFRS 9 B3.2.1, GDPR Article 13

description: Profit center associated with the receivable financing transaction for segment reporting and profitability analysis. Enables attribution of financing costs to specific commodity trading or agricultural business segments.
reference: GAAP ASC 280 (Segment Reporting), IFRS 8, SAP S/4HANA CO Module

description: Maximum monetary exposure retained by the agricultural enterprise under a partial recourse arrangement. Null for full recourse or without recourse transactions. Used for contingent liability disclosure in financial statements per GAAP ASC 460.
reference: GAAP ASC 460 (Guarantees), GAAP ASC 860-20, IFRS 9

description: Defines the credit risk allocation between the agricultural enterprise and the financing institution. Full recourse: enterprise bears all credit risk; partial recourse: shared risk up to a defined limit; without recourse: financing institution assumes all credit risk. Determines whether the receivable qualifies for derecognition under GAAP ASC 860 and IFRS 9.
reference: GAAP ASC 860-20-40, IFRS 9 B3.2.1, FASB ASU 2022-02

description: Amount withheld by the financing institution as a reserve against potential dilution, disputes, or credit losses. Released to the agricultural enterprise upon confirmed customer payment. Equals total_invoice_face_amount minus advance_amount minus factoring_fee_amount.
reference: GAAP ASC 860-20, IFRS 9

description: Amount of the withheld reserve that has been remitted back to the agricultural enterprise following confirmed customer payment collection by the financing institution. Supports reconciliation of the total financing cycle.
reference: GAAP ASC 860-20, IFRS 9

description: Actual date on which the financing arrangement was fully settled, including remittance of reserve amounts and reconciliation of all fees. May differ from maturity_date if customers pay early or late. Null if not yet settled.
reference: GAAP ASC 860-20, IFRS 9

description: Current status of the settlement process for this financing transaction. Tracks whether the financing institution has remitted reserve amounts back to the enterprise following customer payment collection. Overdue indicates maturity_date has passed without full settlement.
reference: GAAP ASC 860, IFRS 9, SAP S/4HANA FI

description: Operational system of record from which this receivable financing record originated. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail requirements. SAP S/4HANA FI and Oracle NetSuite are the primary source systems for AR financing transactions.
reference: SOX Section 404, GAAP ASC 860, SAP S/4HANA FI Module, Oracle NetSuite AR

description: Aggregate face value of all AR invoices included in this financing transaction before any advance rate, fees, or deductions. Represents the gross receivables pool being financed. Used for GAAP ASC 860 derecognition and IFRS 9 impairment calculations.
reference: GAAP ASC 860-20, IFRS 9, SAP S/4HANA FI

description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this receivable financing record. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and data lineage requirements for financial reporting controls.
reference: SOX Section 404, GAAP ASC 860, IFRS 9

description: Primary key for revenue_recognition
Reference to the customer (buyer/counterparty) associated with this revenue recognition event. Used for customer-level revenue reporting and analytics.
reference: GAAP ASC 606, Salesforce CRM, SAP S/4HANA SD Module

description: Reference to the parent accounts receivable invoice that triggered this revenue recognition event. Links the recognition event to the billing document in the invoice domain.
reference: GAAP ASC 606, IFRS 15, SAP S/4HANA FI Module

description: Foreign key linking to invoice.billing_schedule. Business justification: Revenue recognition events are triggered by billing schedule milestones for long-term agricultural contracts. Adding billing_schedule_id to revenue_recognition links the recognition event to the sched
reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.carbon_credit. Business justification: ASC 606 / IFRS 15 revenue recognition for carbon credit sales requires tracing each recognition event to the specific carbon credit instrument being recognized. revenue_recognition has commodity_lot_r
reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: ASC 606 revenue recognition in ag requires commodity-level performance obligation tracking — delivery terms, variable consideration, and recognition triggers differ by commodity. A commodity_id FK ena
reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

description: Foreign key linking to inventory.commodity_lot. Business justification: ASC 606 revenue recognition audit: commodity revenue is recognized upon transfer of control of specific lots (delivery, title transfer). Direct FK replaces denormalized commodity_lot_reference, enabli
reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Revenue recognition is performed at the legal entity level. In multi-entity agriculture operations, ASC 606 revenue recognition reporting by legal entity, consolidation, and statutory financial statem
reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

description: Reference to the underlying customer contract or sales agreement governing the performance obligations for this revenue recognition event. Critical for multi-element agricultural commodity contracts.
reference: GAAP ASC 606 Step 1 (Identify the Contract), IFRS 15

description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: invoice.revenue_recognition carries a cost_center_code text field that is a denormalized reference to finance.cost_center. Revenue recognition events must be tied to specific cost centers for accurate
reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

business_glossary_term: Gl Posting Journal Entry Id (Foreign Key)
description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Revenue recognition events generate GL postings (debit deferred revenue, credit revenue) under ASC 606. In agriculture, grain contract revenue recognition requires specific GL entries. gl_posting_refe
reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

description: Foreign key linking to invoice.invoice_line. Business justification: Revenue recognition under ASC 606/IFRS 15 is performed at the performance obligation level, which in agricultural billing maps to individual commodity lots on invoice lines. revenue_recognition alread
reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

description: Foreign key linking to supply.lot_trace. Business justification: Ag revenue recognition at lot level is required for organic premium tracking, grade-based pricing, and FSMA lot-level financial reporting. Linking revenue_recognition to lot_trace enables lot-level re
reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

description: For reversal or adjustment events, references the original revenue_recognition_event_id that is being reversed or corrected. Enables audit trail linkage between original recognition and its reversal/correction entries.
reference: GAAP ASC 606, SOX, SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR)

description: Reference to the specific performance obligation within the contract that this recognition event satisfies. Under ASC 606/IFRS 15, revenue is recognized when or as each performance obligation is satisfied.
reference: GAAP ASC 606 Step 2 (Identify Performance Obligations), IFRS 15 para 22-30

description: Foreign key linking to supply.shipment. Business justification: Under ASC 606, ag revenue is recognized at shipment (FOB origin) or delivery (FOB destination) based on shipping terms. Linking revenue_recognition to shipment provides the shipment timestamp and term
reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

description: The Bill of Lading (BOL) number associated with the shipment that triggered this revenue recognition event. For FOB (Free On Board) shipping point contracts, the BOL date establishes the title transfer date and thus the revenue recognition date.
reference: GAAP ASC 606, UCC Article 7 (Documents of Title), USDA

description: The timestamp when this revenue recognition event record was first created in the system. Audit trail field required for SOX compliance and data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer.
reference: SOX, GAAP, IFRS

description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the transaction currency in which recognized_amount, deferred_amount, and transaction_price are expressed (e.g., USD, EUR, BRL for Brazilian agricultural exports).
reference: ISO 4217, IFRS, GAAP

description: The portion of the transaction price that has been invoiced or received but not yet recognized as revenue, pending future performance obligation satisfaction. Recorded as a contract liability on the balance sheet. Common in multi-season crop contracts and prepaid input supply agreements.
reference: GAAP ASC 606 para 606-10-45-2, IFRS 15 para 105-106, IFRS

description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for this recognition event (e.g., RRE-2024-000123). Used for audit trails, GL reconciliation, and cross-system referencing in SAP S/4HANA FI.
reference: GAAP ASC 606, SAP S/4HANA FI Module, SOX

description: The foreign currency exchange rate applied to convert the transaction currency amount to the functional currency amount at the recognition event date. Expressed as units of functional currency per one unit of transaction currency.
reference: IFRS IAS 21, GAAP ASC 830

description: The fiscal year and period (YYYY-MM) to which this revenue recognition event is attributed for financial reporting. Determines the accounting period in which recognized revenue appears on the income statement. Aligned with SAP S/4HANA FI fiscal year variant.
reference: GAAP, IFRS, SAP S/4HANA FI Module, SOX

description: The recognized revenue amount translated into the entity's functional currency (typically USD for US-based agricultural operations) using the exchange rate at the recognition event date. Required for consolidated financial reporting under IFRS IAS 21 and GAAP ASC 830.
reference: IFRS IAS 21, GAAP ASC 830, SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Translation

description: The General Ledger account code to which the recognized revenue amount is posted in SAP S/4HANA FI. Determines the revenue line in the income statement (e.g., crop commodity revenue, livestock revenue, agri-service revenue). Critical for financial close and SOX compliance.
reference: GAAP, IFRS, SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Module, SOX

description: The accounting date on which the recognized revenue amount was posted to the General Ledger. May differ from recognition_event_date due to period-end close timing or late adjustments. Governs which fiscal period the revenue falls into.
reference: GAAP ASC 606, IFRS 15, SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Module, SOX

description: The document number or journal entry reference generated in the General Ledger system (SAP S/4HANA) when the revenue recognition amount was posted. Enables direct drill-through from the recognition event to the GL journal entry for audit and reconciliation purposes.
reference: GAAP ASC 606, SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR), SOX

description: Indicates whether this revenue recognition event was triggered by or resulted from a contract modification (change order, price renegotiation, scope change). Contract modifications require reassessment of performance obligations and transaction price allocation under ASC 606/IFRS 15.
reference: GAAP ASC 606 para 606-10-25-10 through 606-10-25-13, IFRS 15 para 18-21

description: Indicates whether the variable consideration estimate included in this recognition event has been constrained (i.e., limited to the amount highly probable of not resulting in a significant revenue reversal). Required disclosure under ASC 606 constraint guidance for agricultural price-variable contracts.
reference: GAAP ASC 606 para 606-10-32-11, IFRS 15 para 56-58

description: Free-text field for additional context, auditor comments, or explanatory notes related to this revenue recognition event. Used to document non-standard recognition scenarios, regulatory exceptions, or manual override justifications.
reference: GAAP ASC 606, SOX audit documentation requirements

description: For over-time revenue recognition, the cumulative percentage of the performance obligation satisfied as of this recognition event date. Expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00). Used to calculate the recognized amount for long-term contract farming, agronomy services, and multi-season supply agreements.
reference: GAAP ASC 606 para 606-10-25-31 through 606-10-25-37, IFRS 15 para 39-45

description: SAP CO profit center code to which this revenue recognition event is attributed. Enables profitability analysis by business unit, crop type, or geographic region within the agricultural enterprise.
reference: SAP S/4HANA CO Module, GAAP, IFRS

description: The business date on which the revenue recognition event occurred — i.e., the date the performance obligation was satisfied and revenue became recognizable. For commodity sales, this is typically the title transfer date per the Bill of Lading (BOL) or weight ticket.
reference: GAAP ASC 606, IFRS 15, USDA COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) regulations

description: Current lifecycle status of the revenue recognition event. 'Pending' indicates awaiting trigger conditions; 'recognized' indicates revenue has been posted to GL; 'deferred' indicates revenue is held pending future obligation satisfaction; 'reversed' indicates a prior recognition has been corrected; 'cancelled' indicates the event was voided.
reference: GAAP ASC 606, IFRS 15, SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Accounting

description: The specific business event or condition that triggered this revenue recognition event. Identifies whether recognition was triggered by physical delivery confirmation, legal title transfer (commodity), contract milestone completion, period-end proportional allocation, consignment sale by the buyer, or customer invoice acceptance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: delivery_confirmed|title_transfer|contract_milestone|period_end_allocation|consignment_sale|invoice_acceptance — promote to reference product]
reference: GAAP ASC 606 para 606-10-25-30, IFRS 15 para 38

description: Classification of the revenue recognition method applied to this event. 'Point_in_time' applies to standard crop commodity deliveries; 'over_time' applies to long-term service or contract farming arrangements; 'bill_and_hold' applies where goods are invoiced but not yet shipped; 'consignment_release' applies when consigned agricultural goods are sold by the consignee; 'commodity_title_transfer' applies to grain elevator and commodity exchange transactions where title transfer timing governs recognition.
reference: GAAP ASC 606 para 606-10-25-27, IFRS 15 para 35-38, USDA commodity trading regulations

description: The gross monetary amount of revenue recognized in this event, expressed in the transaction currency. For agricultural commodity sales, this reflects the agreed contract price multiplied by the delivered quantity (weight-ticket reconciled). Core financial metric for revenue reporting under ASC 606/IFRS 15.
reference: GAAP ASC 606 Step 5 (Recognize Revenue), IFRS 15 para 46, IFRS

description: High-level classification of the revenue type being recognized. Enables disaggregated revenue reporting required under ASC 606 and IFRS 15 disclosure requirements. Categories reflect the primary agricultural revenue streams: crop commodity sales, livestock sales, agricultural services (custom farming, agronomy), input supply (seed, fertilizer, chemicals), and land lease/rental income.
reference: GAAP ASC 606 para 606-10-50-5 (Disaggregation of Revenue), IFRS 15 para 114-115

description: Descriptive reason code or narrative explaining why a previously recognized revenue event was reversed. Applicable when recognition_status is 'reversed'. Common reasons in agriculture include: contract cancellation, commodity rejection at delivery, quality dispute, weight-ticket discrepancy, or price renegotiation.
reference: GAAP ASC 606, IFRS 15, SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Accounting, SOX

description: The Sales Order (SO) number from SAP S/4HANA SD module that originated the revenue stream for this recognition event. Provides traceability from the customer order through invoicing to revenue recognition.
reference: SAP S/4HANA SD Module, GAAP ASC 606

description: The shipping/delivery terms (Incoterms) governing when title and risk of loss transfer from seller to buyer. Directly determines the point-in-time at which revenue recognition criteria are met. FOB (Free On Board) shipping point means recognition at shipment; FOB destination means recognition at delivery. Critical for agricultural commodity export transactions.
reference: GAAP ASC 606, Incoterms 2020 (ICC), USDA export regulations

description: Identifies the operational system of record that originated this revenue recognition event. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer. SAP S/4HANA Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR) is the primary source for enterprise agricultural operations.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR), Oracle NetSuite, Granular Farm Management

description: The total transaction price allocated to this performance obligation as determined under ASC 606 Step 3 (Determine Transaction Price). Includes fixed consideration and any variable consideration estimates. For commodity contracts, reflects the agreed price per unit multiplied by contracted quantity.
reference: GAAP ASC 606 Step 3, IFRS 15 para 47-72

description: The timestamp when this revenue recognition event record was last modified. Tracks adjustments, status changes, and corrections to the recognition event for audit trail and SOX compliance purposes.
reference: SOX, GAAP, IFRS

description: The estimated amount of variable consideration included in the transaction price for this recognition event. Variable consideration in agriculture includes price adjustments for commodity grade/quality premiums or discounts, volume rebates, weather-contingent pricing, and harvest yield-based true-ups. Constrained to the amount that is highly probable of not reversing per ASC 606 constraint guidance.
reference: GAAP ASC 606 para 606-10-32-5 through 606-10-32-9, IFRS 15 para 50-59

description: Reference to the weight ticket number used to reconcile the delivered quantity of agricultural commodities (grain, produce, livestock) against the invoiced quantity. Weight-ticket reconciliation is a critical agricultural-specific step in confirming the quantity basis for revenue recognition.
reference: USDA Grain Standards Act, GAAP ASC 606 Step 4 (Allocate Transaction Price)

description: Unique system-generated identifier for the bad debt write-off transaction record in the accounts receivable (AR) ledger.
reference: GAAP ASC 310-10; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

description: Reference to the agricultural customer (e.g., food manufacturer, distributor, cooperative) whose AR balance is being written off. Primary party reference for the write-off transaction.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Customer Account; Salesforce CRM

description: Reference to the originating invoice record being written off. Links to the invoice.invoice product for full invoice detail and reconciliation.
reference: GAAP ASC 310-10; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR

description: Reference to the customer billing account against which the write-off is applied. Identifies the AR customer account in the general ledger.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Oracle NetSuite AR

description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Write-offs are processed by a specific legal entity. In multi-entity agriculture operations, bad debt reporting by legal entity is required for statutory financial statements, tax deductibility analys
reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

business_glossary_term: Gl Posting Journal Entry Id (Foreign Key)
description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Bad debt write-offs require GL postings (debit allowance for doubtful accounts, credit AR). In agriculture, write-offs for grain buyer defaults or input customer non-payment require specific GL entrie
reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

description: Foreign key linking to invoice.dispute. Business justification: write_off.dispute_case_reference is a denormalized string reference to the dispute record. Bad debt write-offs in agricultural AR frequently follow failed dispute resolution. Normalizing to invoice_di
reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

business_glossary_term: Allowance for Doubtful Accounts GL Code
description: GL account code for the Allowance for Doubtful Accounts contra-asset account offset entry. Under the allowance method, the write-off reduces this account rather than directly expensing. Required for GAAP ASC 310-10 indirect write-off method.
reference: GAAP ASC 310-10; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL

description: Gross monetary amount of the accounts receivable balance being written off in the transaction currency. Represents the uncollectable AR balance removed from the books.
reference: GAAP ASC 310-10; IFRS 9; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR

description: Write-off amount converted to the company's functional (reporting) currency using the exchange rate at the time of write-off. Required for GAAP/IFRS financial statement reporting and GL posting.
reference: GAAP ASC 830; IFRS 21; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Translation

description: Name or role identifier of the individual or committee that authorized the write-off per the SOX-compliant delegation of authority matrix. Required for audit trail and internal controls documentation.
reference: SOX Section 404; GAAP ASC 310-10; Internal Controls Framework

description: Date on which the write-off was formally approved by the designated approval authority. Distinct from the write-off posting date; required for SOX segregation of duties and approval workflow audit trail.
reference: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA FI Workflow

description: Hierarchical approval tier required and obtained for this write-off based on the amount threshold in the delegation of authority policy. Higher write-off amounts require escalation to senior financial officers per SOX controls.
reference: SOX Section 404; Internal Audit Controls; GAAP

description: External collection agency case or account reference number when the debt was referred to a third-party collection agency prior to write-off. Supports recovery tracking and agency fee reconciliation.
reference: Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA); SAP S/4HANA FI-AR

description: SAP cost center code to which the bad debt expense is allocated for management accounting and OPEX reporting. Enables attribution of write-off costs to specific agricultural business units or regions.
reference: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Center Accounting; GAAP

description: Timestamp when the write-off record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation marker required for SOX-compliant financial record keeping.
reference: SOX Section 404; GAAP; ISO 8601

description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the transaction currency in which the write-off amount is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD). Supports multi-currency agricultural commodity trading operations.
reference: ISO 4217; GAAP ASC 830; IFRS 21

description: Legal name of the agricultural customer at the time of write-off. Captured as a denormalized field for audit trail integrity and historical reporting, as the customer record may change post-write-off.
reference: GDPR Article 4; SOX Section 404; GAAP ASC 310-10

description: Foreign currency exchange rate applied to convert the write-off transaction amount to the functional currency at the time of write-off posting. Required for multi-currency AR reconciliation.
reference: GAAP ASC 830; IFRS 21; SAP S/4HANA FI Exchange Rate

description: Accounting fiscal period (YYYY-PP format) in which the write-off is recognized for financial reporting. Aligns with the agricultural company's fiscal calendar for period-end close and GAAP/IFRS reporting.
reference: GAAP ASC 310-10; IFRS 9; SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year/Period

description: GL account code to which the bad debt expense is posted (typically the Bad Debt Expense or Allowance for Doubtful Accounts account). Required for GAAP revenue accounting and financial statement preparation.
reference: GAAP ASC 310-10; IFRS 9; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Chart of Accounts

description: Date on which the write-off journal entry was posted to the general ledger. Determines the accounting period for bad debt expense recognition per GAAP/IFRS period-end close requirements.
reference: GAAP ASC 310-10; IFRS 9; SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Date

description: Comma-separated list of invoice numbers included in this write-off transaction when multiple invoices are consolidated into a single write-off event. Supports AR aging reconciliation and audit trail. For single-invoice write-offs, contains the single invoice number.
reference: GAAP ASC 310-10; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Clearing

description: Indicates whether the write-off qualifies as a tax-deductible bad debt expense under applicable tax law. Drives tax provision calculations and deferred tax asset recognition.
reference: IRS Revenue Ruling; GAAP ASC 740; IFRS IAS 12

description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, legal counsel comments, or credit committee observations related to the write-off decision. Supports comprehensive audit documentation for SOX compliance.
reference: SOX Section 404; GAAP ASC 310-10

description: Total face value of the original invoice(s) at the time of issuance before any partial payments or credits. Enables calculation of partial write-off percentage and supports credit risk analytics.
reference: GAAP ASC 310-10; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR

description: Total payments previously received and applied against the invoice(s) prior to the write-off. The net uncollectable balance equals original_invoice_amount minus partial_payment_applied.
reference: GAAP ASC 310-10; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR

description: SAP profit center code for segment-level P&L reporting of bad debt expense. Supports EBITDA analysis by agricultural business segment (e.g., crop inputs, livestock, grain trading).
reference: SAP S/4HANA CO Profit Center Accounting; IFRS 8 Segment Reporting

description: Categorized business reason for the bad debt write-off. Agriculture-specific reasons include crop_failure_hardship (customer unable to pay due to crop loss event) and dispute_settlement (negotiated resolution). Required for GAAP bad debt expense classification and management reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bankruptcy|insolvency|crop_failure_hardship|dispute_settlement|statute_of_limitations|customer_deceased|other — promote to reference product]
reference: GAAP ASC 310-10; FSMA; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Reason Code

description: Free-text narrative providing additional context for the write-off reason. For crop failure hardship cases, may include crop type, affected season, and loss event reference. Supports audit documentation and SOX compliance.
reference: SOX Section 404; GAAP ASC 310-10

description: Total amount subsequently recovered from the customer after the write-off was posted. Populated when recovery_flag is True. Used to record bad debt recovery income and adjust net bad debt expense reporting.
reference: GAAP ASC 310-10; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR

description: Date on which the recovered amount was received from the customer. Used for period-accurate bad debt recovery income recognition and cash flow reporting.
reference: GAAP ASC 310-10; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR

description: Indicates whether any subsequent recovery of the written-off amount has been initiated or received. When True, triggers monitoring of recovery transactions and potential reversal of bad debt expense per GAAP.
reference: GAAP ASC 310-10; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Recovery

description: Date on which the write-off was reversed in the general ledger. Populated only when reversal_flag is True. Determines the accounting period for the reversal entry.
reference: GAAP ASC 310-10; SAP S/4HANA FI Reversal

description: Indicates whether this write-off has been reversed (e.g., due to subsequent full payment or erroneous posting). When True, the write-off_status should reflect 'reversed' and a reversal document reference should be present.
reference: GAAP ASC 310-10; SAP S/4HANA FI Reversal Document

description: Operational system of record from which the write-off transaction originated. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation between ERP systems in multi-system agricultural enterprise environments.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Oracle NetSuite AR; Granular Farm Management

description: Estimated tax deduction or tax benefit amount associated with the bad debt write-off. Relevant for income tax reporting where bad debt deductions are allowable under applicable tax regulations.
reference: IRS Revenue Ruling; GAAP ASC 740; IFRS IAS 12

description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the write-off record. Tracks changes through the approval workflow and any post-posting amendments for SOX audit trail completeness.
reference: SOX Section 404; GAAP; ISO 8601

description: Weight ticket number associated with the commodity delivery underlying the written-off invoice. Supports weight-ticket-based AR reconciliation specific to grain elevator and commodity trading operations.
reference: USDA Grain Standards Act; SAP S/4HANA MM; Granular Farm Management

description: The business event date on which the bad debt write-off was formally executed and recognized. Used for GAAP bad debt expense recognition in the correct accounting period.
reference: GAAP ASC 310-10; IFRS 9; SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Date

description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for the write-off transaction. Used in audit trails, SOX compliance documentation, and GL posting references. Format: WO-YYYY-NNNNNN.
reference: SOX Section 404; GAAP ASC 310-10; SAP S/4HANA FI Document Number

description: Current lifecycle state of the write-off transaction within the SOX-compliant approval and GL posting workflow. Tracks progression from initial submission through approval, GL posting, and any subsequent reversal.
reference: SOX Section 404; GAAP ASC 310-10; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR

description: Primary key for billing_account
Reference to the master customer entity in the CRM or ERP customer master. Links the AR billing account to the corresponding buyer record in Salesforce CRM or SAP SD customer master.
reference: SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce CRM; GAAP ASC 606

description: Code identifying the reason for any deduction taken by the payer against the invoice amount (e.g., quality deduction, moisture dockage, freight deduction, promotional allowance). Common in agricultural commodity billing where buyers deduct for grade, moisture, or foreign material.
reference: USDA GIPSA Grain Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD Deduction Reason; Oracle NetSuite Deduction Management

description: The last date by which payment must be received to qualify for the early payment discount. Used to validate whether the early_payment_discount_amount was legitimately earned. Derived from invoice date and payment terms.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Terms; Oracle NetSuite Discount Date; GAAP ASC 606-10-32

description: Monetary value of the trade or cash discount applied at the time of payment allocation. Represents the discount actually utilized by the payer, which may differ from the discount offered. Used in AR reconciliation and discount expense reporting.
reference: GAAP ASC 606-10-32; SAP S/4HANA FI Cash Discount; Oracle NetSuite Discount Applied

description: Monetary value of the early payment discount earned by the payer for settling the invoice before the discount due date. Distinct from standard trade discounts; tied to payment terms such as 2/10 Net 30 common in agricultural supply chain billing.
reference: GAAP ASC 310-10; SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Terms Discount; Oracle NetSuite Early Payment Discount

description: Foreign currency exchange rate applied to convert the transaction currency amount to the base/functional currency at the time of allocation. Sourced from the ERP system's daily exchange rate table. Required for IFRS 21 and GAAP ASC 830 compliance.
reference: IFRS 21; GAAP ASC 830; SAP S/4HANA FI Exchange Rate; Oracle NetSuite Currency Exchange Rate

description: The general ledger (GL) account code to which this payment allocation is posted for revenue recognition and AR clearing. Ensures proper accounting treatment per GAAP/IFRS chart of accounts. Sourced from SAP FI GL account determination or Oracle NetSuite account mapping.
reference: GAAP ASC 606; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA FI GL Account; Oracle NetSuite Chart of Accounts

description: Indicates whether this payment allocation is between entities within the same corporate group (intercompany transaction). Required for intercompany elimination in consolidated financial statements per GAAP ASC 810 and IFRS 10.
reference: GAAP ASC 810 Consolidation; IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; SAP S/4HANA FI Intercompany

description: The date and time when this payment allocation record was most recently modified. Tracks changes to allocation status, amounts, or reconciliation state. Required for data lineage and SOX audit trail.
reference: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA FI Change Document; Oracle NetSuite Last Modified Date

description: Reference identifier for the intercompany or counterparty netting arrangement when allocation_type is 'netting'. Used in agricultural supply chain scenarios where a company is both buyer and seller to the same counterparty (e.g., grain merchandiser netting payables against receivables).
reference: GAAP ASC 210-20 Offsetting; IFRS 32 Financial Instruments Presentation; SAP S/4HANA FI Netting

description: Free-text notes or comments entered by the AR specialist regarding this payment allocation. May include details about partial payment agreements, dispute resolutions, weight-ticket discrepancies, or special handling instructions for seasonal payment arrangements.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Text; Oracle NetSuite Memo

description: The accounting period posting date for this allocation in the general ledger (GL). May differ from the allocation date when period-end adjustments are made. Determines the fiscal period for revenue recognition and AR aging per GAAP/IFRS.
reference: GAAP ASC 606; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Date; Oracle NetSuite Posting Period

description: SAP Controlling (CO) profit center code for segment reporting and profitability analysis by business unit (e.g., crop division, livestock division, agri-supply). Supports EBITDA reporting by agricultural business segment.
reference: SAP S/4HANA CO Profit Center Accounting; IFRS 8 Operating Segments; GAAP ASC 280

description: Status of the bank reconciliation matching for this allocation: unreconciled (not yet matched to bank statement), matched (confirmed against bank statement), partially_matched (partial bank confirmation), exception (discrepancy requiring investigation), cleared (fully reconciled and closed). Essential for month-end close and cash management in agricultural operations.
reference: GAAP ASC 310; SAP S/4HANA FI Bank Reconciliation; Oracle NetSuite Bank Reconciliation

description: The date on which this payment allocation was reversed. Populated only when allocation_status is 'reversed'. Used for AR aging recalculation and audit trail documentation.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Reversal Date; Oracle NetSuite Void Date; GAAP ASC 310

description: Business reason for reversing this payment allocation (e.g., returned check, bank rejection, incorrect application, duplicate payment). Populated only when allocation_status is 'reversed'. Required for audit trail and AR dispute management.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Reversal Reason; Oracle NetSuite Void Reason; GAAP ASC 310

description: The bank value date on which funds were credited or debited, used for cash flow reporting and bank reconciliation. May differ from the posting date in agricultural cooperative payment cycles and commodity settlement workflows.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Value Date; Oracle NetSuite Bank Value Date; IFRS 9

description: Difference between the invoice amount and the payment allocated, representing unresolved discrepancies such as pricing disputes, weight-ticket measurement differences, or deduction claims. Positive value indicates underpayment; negative indicates overpayment. Critical for weight-ticket settlement reconciliation in grain and commodity billing.
reference: GAAP ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA FI Residual Item; Oracle NetSuite Payment Variance

description: Reference to the grain elevator or commodity scale weight ticket associated with this payment allocation. Critical for weight-ticket settlement reconciliation in grain, oilseed, and commodity billing workflows where payment is based on net weight delivered.
reference: USDA Grain Inspection Packers and Stockyards Administration (GIPSA); SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Receipt; Granular Farm Management

description: Monetary amount of the invoice balance written off as uncollectable or as an approved variance adjustment. Used in bad debt management, small balance write-offs, and weight-ticket variance clearance in commodity billing workflows.
reference: GAAP ASC 310-10-35; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; SAP S/4HANA FI Write-Off; Oracle NetSuite Bad Debt Write-Off

description: Unique surrogate identifier for each payment term configuration record in the agricultural billing reference master.
reference: GAAP ASC 606, IFRS 15

description: Comma-separated list of commodity categories to which this payment term is applicable (e.g., 'grain,oilseed', 'livestock', 'produce', 'all'). Supports commodity-specific settlement schedules such as deferred grain payment programs and livestock settlement windows. Null indicates applicability to all commodity types.
reference: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service, GAAP ASC 606, SAP S/4HANA MM

description: SAP S/4HANA company code(s) for which this payment term is valid. Comma-separated if applicable to multiple company codes. Null indicates applicability across all company codes. Supports multi-entity agricultural enterprise structures.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Configuration, GAAP, IFRS

description: Customer segment classification for which this payment term is designed. Allows differentiated term offerings for growers, cooperatives, distributors, and processors within the agricultural supply chain. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: all|grower|cooperative|distributor|processor|retailer|export — promote to reference product]
reference: Salesforce CRM Customer Segmentation, GAAP ASC 606, GLOBALG.A.P.

description: SAP S/4HANA sales organization code(s) for which this payment term is valid. Comma-separated if applicable to multiple sales organizations. Null indicates global applicability across all sales organizations.
reference: SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Organization Configuration

description: Name or employee identifier of the finance or credit manager who approved this payment term configuration for use. Supports SOX internal controls over financial reporting and segregation of duties requirements.
reference: SOX Section 302/404, GAAP Internal Controls, SAP S/4HANA FI Authorization

description: Date on which this payment term configuration was formally approved by the authorized finance or credit manager. Supports SOX audit trail and change management documentation.
reference: SOX Section 302/404, GAAP Internal Controls

description: Defines the reference date from which net due days and discount days are calculated. Agricultural-specific options include weight_ticket_date (grain elevator settlements) and harvest_completion_date (post-harvest deferred programs). Maps to SAP S/4HANA payment term baseline date configuration.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Terms Baseline Date, GAAP ASC 606

description: Timestamp when this payment term configuration record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
reference: SOX Section 404, GAAP ASC 606, ISO 22000

description: Minimum approved credit limit (in functional currency) that a customer must hold to be eligible for this payment term. Supports credit risk management for extended or deferred agricultural payment programs. Null if no minimum credit limit is required.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management (FCV), GAAP ASC 310

description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which this payment term's monetary thresholds and discount calculations are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD). Supports multi-currency agricultural export transactions.
reference: ISO 4217, IFRS 15, SAP S/4HANA FI

description: Maximum number of calendar days that payment may be deferred from the invoice date under a seasonal deferral program, regardless of when the trigger event occurs. Caps the deferral window to manage credit exposure. Null when is_seasonal_deferral is false.
reference: USDA Farm Service Agency, GAAP ASC 606, IFRS 15

description: The business event that triggers the start of the payment window for seasonally deferred terms. For example, 'harvest_completion' starts the net due days clock after crop harvest is recorded. Null when is_seasonal_deferral is false.
reference: USDA Farm Service Agency, GAAP ASC 606 Revenue Recognition, Granular Farm Management

description: Number of days from the baseline date within which payment must be received to qualify for the first-tier early payment discount percentage. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA ZBD1T field. Null if no early payment discount applies.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI ZBD1T, GAAP ASC 606 Variable Consideration

description: Number of days from the baseline date within which payment must be received to qualify for the second-tier early payment discount. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA ZBD2T field. Null if no second discount tier applies.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI ZBD2T, GAAP ASC 606 Variable Consideration

description: Percentage discount applied to the invoice amount if payment is received within discount_days_1. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0200 = 2%). Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA ZBD1P field. Null if no early payment discount applies.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI ZBD1P, GAAP ASC 606 Variable Consideration, IFRS 15

description: Percentage discount applied to the invoice amount if payment is received within discount_days_2 but after discount_days_1. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA ZBD2P field. Null if no second discount tier applies.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI ZBD2P, GAAP ASC 606 Variable Consideration, IFRS 15

description: SAP S/4HANA dunning procedure code assigned to this payment term, controlling the escalation schedule for overdue AR notices. Seasonal agricultural terms may use specialized dunning procedures that account for harvest timing before escalating collection actions.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Dunning (F150), GAAP ASC 310

description: Date from which this payment term configuration becomes valid and may be applied to new invoices, sales orders, or purchase orders. Supports seasonal term activation aligned with crop or livestock cycles.
reference: GAAP ASC 606, IFRS 15, SAP S/4HANA FI

description: Native payment term key as stored in the source ERP system (SAP S/4HANA ZTERM field, Oracle NetSuite term ID). Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational system of record.
reference: SAP S/4HANA SD/FI ZTERM, Oracle NetSuite Payment Terms

description: Date after which this payment term configuration is no longer valid for assignment to new transactions. Null indicates an open-ended term with no planned expiration. Supports seasonal program sunset dates.
reference: GAAP ASC 606, IFRS 15, SAP S/4HANA FI

business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Compliant Flag
description: Indicates whether this payment term configuration has been reviewed and confirmed compliant with FSMA supplier payment provisions, particularly for produce safety rule supplier agreements and preventive controls.
reference: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA), 21 CFR Part 112

description: Default General Ledger account code associated with revenue or AR postings under this payment term. Used for automated GL determination in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO integration. Supports revenue recognition per GAAP/IFRS.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO GL Account Determination, GAAP ASC 606, IFRS 15

description: Total number of installment payments required under this term when is_installment is true. For example, 3 for a three-payment seasonal schedule. Null when is_installment is false.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Installment Payment Terms, GAAP ASC 606

description: Defines how installment amounts are distributed across the payment schedule. 'harvest_triggered' supports agricultural deferred programs where installment timing is tied to crop harvest completion events. Null when is_installment is false.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Installment Terms, GAAP ASC 606, Granular Farm Management

description: Indicates whether this payment term requires payment in multiple installments rather than a single lump sum. When true, installment_count and installment_schedule_type define the installment structure. Common for large agricultural equipment purchases and seasonal input financing.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Installment Payment Terms, GAAP ASC 606, IFRS 15

description: Indicates whether this payment term includes a seasonal deferral provision, allowing payment to be deferred to a post-harvest or post-season window. Characteristic of agricultural deferred grain payment programs and spring input financing.
reference: USDA Farm Service Agency Payment Programs, GAAP ASC 606, Granular Farm Management

description: Number of calendar days beyond the due date before late payment penalties begin to accrue. Provides a grace window before penalty charges are triggered. Null if no grace period applies.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Dunning, GAAP ASC 310

description: Annual percentage rate applied to overdue invoice balances as a late payment penalty or interest charge. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0150 = 1.5% per annum). Null if no late payment penalty applies under this term.
reference: GAAP ASC 310, IFRS 9, SAP S/4HANA FI Dunning Configuration

description: Number of calendar days from the invoice date (or baseline date) by which full payment is due. For example, 30 for Net 30 terms. Core field in SAP S/4HANA payment term configuration (ZBD3T). Drives AR due date calculation.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI ZBD3T, GAAP ASC 606, IFRS 15

description: Payment term identifier as defined in Oracle NetSuite GL/AR module. Populated when the term originates from or is synchronized with NetSuite. Supports dual-ERP environments where SAP S/4HANA and Oracle NetSuite coexist.
reference: Oracle NetSuite AR Payment Terms Configuration

description: Restricts the allowable payment methods under this term. For example, large grain settlement programs may require ACH or wire transfer only. 'none' indicates no restriction. Maps to SAP S/4HANA payment method configuration.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Methods, NACHA ACH Rules

description: Indicates whether the commodity price must be fixed (priced) before the payment due date clock starts. Relevant for deferred pricing grain contracts (basis contracts, hedge-to-arrive) where the final invoice amount is not determined at delivery.
reference: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service, CFTC Commodity Exchange Act, GAAP ASC 606

description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the payment term configuration, as defined in SAP S/4HANA FI/SD module (e.g., NET30, DEFGRAIN90, LSTK45). Used on invoices, sales orders, and purchase orders for term lookup.
reference: SAP S/4HANA SD/FI Payment Terms Configuration, GAAP ASC 606

description: Detailed narrative description of the payment term, including applicable conditions, seasonal rules, commodity restrictions, and any special settlement provisions relevant to agricultural billing scenarios.
reference: GAAP ASC 606, IFRS 15, GLOBALG.A.P.

description: Human-readable name of the payment term configuration (e.g., 'Net 30 Days', 'Deferred Grain Payment 90 Days Post-Harvest', 'Livestock Settlement 14 Days'). Displayed on customer-facing documents and AR aging reports.
reference: SAP S/4HANA SD Payment Terms, GAAP ASC 606

description: Current lifecycle status of the payment term configuration. Inactive or deprecated terms are retained for historical invoice reference but cannot be assigned to new transactions.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Configuration Lifecycle, GAAP ASC 606

description: Classification of the payment term by its structural type. Supports agricultural-specific types including deferred seasonal programs (post-harvest grain payment windows), commodity-price-based settlement, and livestock consignment settlement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard_net|early_payment_discount|deferred_seasonal|installment|consignment_settlement|commodity_price_based|prepayment — promote to reference product]
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Terms, GAAP ASC 606, IFRS 15

description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this payment term configuration record, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change tracking and audit compliance.
reference: SOX Section 404, GAAP ASC 606, ISO 22000

description: Indicates whether payment under this term requires reconciliation against a weight ticket (scale ticket) before the invoice due date is triggered. Critical for grain elevator and commodity settlement billing scenarios where final payment amount depends on certified weight.
reference: USDA Grain Inspection Packers and Stockyards Administration (GIPSA), GAAP ASC 606

description: Primary key for budget

reference: SAP SuccessFactors; SAP S/4HANA CO; SOX; GAAP

description: Reference to the employee or manager formally accountable for this procurement budget. The budget owner is responsible for approving spend requests, monitoring variance, and authorizing budget revisions. Sourced from SAP SuccessFactors HR.
reference: SAP SuccessFactors; SAP S/4HANA CO; SOX financial controls

description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: Procurement budgets in agriculture are allocated by commodity (e.g., corn seed budget, soybean fertilizer budget). Commodity-level budget tracking enables spend-to-budget reporting by crop and drives
reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

description: Reference to the SAP CO cost center to which this procurement budget is allocated. Enables OPEX/CAPEX tracking and spend analytics by organizational unit.
reference: SAP S/4HANA CO module; GAAP; IFRS

description: Foreign key linking to finance.crop_enterprise_budget. Business justification: The procurement operational budget references the finance-side crop enterprise budget to ensure input procurement spending aligns with the crop-level financial plan. Supports integrated budget managem
reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

description: Reference to the farm enterprise or business unit to which this budget is assigned. Supports spend analytics segmented by farm operation within the agricultural enterprise.
reference: Granular Farm Management; SAP S/4HANA CO Profit Center

reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

description: The total monetary value of procurement spend actually incurred to date against this budget, based on posted Goods Receipt Notes (GRNs) and approved vendor invoices processed through SAP MM/FI and Oracle NetSuite AP. Represents confirmed expenditure.
reference: SAP S/4HANA MM/FI; Oracle NetSuite AP; GAAP; IFRS

description: The total monetary amount formally allocated and approved for procurement spend within this budget record for the defined period and input category. Represents the authorized spending ceiling before any commitments or actuals are recorded.
reference: SAP S/4HANA CO; Granular Farm Management; GAAP; IFRS

description: The date on which this procurement budget was formally approved by the designated approver. Marks the transition from draft to approved status and establishes the authorization date for audit and SOX compliance purposes.
reference: SAP S/4HANA CO; SOX; GAAP

description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this procurement budget record within the ERP and farm management systems. Used for cross-system reconciliation between SAP CO and Granular Farm Management.
reference: SAP S/4HANA CO; Oracle NetSuite; Granular Farm Management

description: Human-readable descriptive name for the procurement budget record (e.g., 'FY2025 Q2 Seed & Fertilizer - North Farm'). Used in reporting dashboards and budget owner communications.
reference: Granular Farm Management; SAP CO

description: Current lifecycle state of the procurement budget record. Draft budgets are under preparation; approved budgets are authorized for spend; active budgets have open commitments; frozen budgets are temporarily suspended; closed budgets have completed their period; cancelled budgets are voided.
reference: SAP S/4HANA CO; Granular Farm Management; GAAP

business_glossary_term: Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) vs Operational Expenditure (OPEX) Classification
description: Indicates whether this procurement budget is classified as Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) for long-term asset acquisition (e.g., irrigation infrastructure, equipment) or Operational Expenditure (OPEX) for recurring inputs (e.g., seeds, fertilizers, agrochemicals, fuel). Critical for financial reporting under GAAP and IFRS.
reference: GAAP; IFRS; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO

description: The total monetary value of open and confirmed Purchase Orders (POs) that have been raised against this budget but not yet invoiced or goods-receipted. Derived from open PO commitments in SAP MM. Represents encumbered budget that is no longer freely available.
reference: SAP S/4HANA MM/CO; Oracle NetSuite; GAAP commitment accounting

description: The timestamp when this procurement budget record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation event required for SOX financial controls and data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer.
reference: SAP S/4HANA CO; SOX; GAAP; ISO 22000

description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which all monetary amounts on this budget record are denominated (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency agricultural operations and IFRS reporting.
reference: ISO 4217; IFRS; SAP S/4HANA FI

description: The fiscal period granularity of this budget record — annual for full-year budgets or quarterly (Q1–Q4) for sub-annual allocations. Supports both annual OPEX planning and quarterly reforecast cycles.
reference: SAP S/4HANA CO; Granular Farm Management; GAAP; IFRS

description: The fiscal year (e.g., 2025) to which this procurement budget allocation applies. Aligns with the agricultural enterprise's financial reporting calendar in SAP FI/CO.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; GAAP; IFRS

description: Code identifying the agricultural growing season (e.g., 'SPRING-2025', 'FALL-2024') to which this procurement budget is aligned. Enables spend analytics by crop season, supporting seasonal OPEX planning and year-over-year comparison.
reference: Granular Farm Management; USDA crop calendar; SAP S/4HANA CO

description: Classification of the agricultural input type covered by this budget record. Drives spend analytics by input category and supports NPK fertilizer, AI (Active Ingredient) agrochemical, and feed ingredient cost tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: seed|fertilizer|agrochemical|feed|fuel|parts|supplies|other — promote to reference product]
reference: USDA; EPA; APHIS; SAP S/4HANA MM material group; Granular Farm Management

description: Indicates whether this procurement budget record is locked against further modifications (True) or remains open for amendment (False). Budgets are typically locked at period close or upon reaching a frozen status to preserve financial integrity.
reference: SAP S/4HANA CO; SOX; GAAP

description: The date on which this procurement budget record was most recently revised or amended. Tracks the most recent budget adjustment event, supporting audit trails and reforecast cycle management.
reference: SAP S/4HANA CO; Granular Farm Management; GAAP

description: Free-text field for budget owner or finance controller annotations, including justification for budget revisions, seasonal adjustments, or compliance notes related to EPA/APHIS regulated input categories such as agrochemicals.
reference: SAP S/4HANA CO; Granular Farm Management

description: The initial budget amount as approved at the start of the budget period, before any revisions or amendments. Preserved for variance analysis comparing original plan versus revised plan versus actuals — a key OPEX control metric.
reference: SAP S/4HANA CO; Granular Farm Management; GAAP; IFRS

description: The calendar date on which this budget period closes. Defines the boundary for spend commitment and actuals accumulation within this budget record.
reference: SAP S/4HANA CO; GAAP; IFRS

description: The calendar date on which this budget period becomes effective. For annual budgets this is typically the first day of the fiscal year; for quarterly budgets it is the first day of the quarter.
reference: SAP S/4HANA CO; GAAP; IFRS

description: SAP CO profit center code associated with this procurement budget, enabling profitability analysis by farm enterprise or crop production unit. Supports EBITDA reporting at the farm-level granularity.
reference: SAP S/4HANA CO; GAAP; IFRS

description: The unencumbered budget balance remaining for new procurement commitments, calculated as allocated_amount minus committed_amount minus actual_spend_amount. Provides real-time budget availability for procurement controllers and farm managers.
reference: SAP S/4HANA CO; Granular Farm Management; GAAP

description: Sequential integer counter tracking how many times this procurement budget has been revised since initial approval. Version 0 represents the original approved budget; each subsequent amendment increments this counter. Supports budget reforecast audit trails.
reference: SAP S/4HANA CO; Granular Farm Management; SOX

description: The percentage of the allocated budget that has been consumed by actual spend to date (actual_spend_amount / allocated_amount × 100). A key KPI for procurement controllers to monitor budget utilization rate and flag potential overspend risk.
reference: SAP S/4HANA CO; Granular Farm Management; GAAP

description: The total monetary amount transferred into this budget record from other budget lines or cost centers during the period. Supports budget reallocation tracking between input categories or farm enterprises.
reference: SAP S/4HANA CO; GAAP; IFRS

description: The total monetary amount transferred out of this budget record to other budget lines or cost centers during the period. Together with transfer_in_amount, enables full reconciliation of budget movements.
reference: SAP S/4HANA CO; GAAP; IFRS

description: The timestamp when this procurement budget record was most recently modified. Supports incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer and provides the audit trail update event for SOX compliance.
reference: SAP S/4HANA CO; SOX; GAAP

description: The monetary difference between the allocated budget amount and the total of committed plus actual spend. A positive value indicates underspend; a negative value indicates overspend. Used for OPEX control reporting and KPI dashboards.
reference: SAP S/4HANA CO; Granular Farm Management; GAAP; IFRS

description: The variance amount expressed as a percentage of the allocated budget amount (variance_amount / allocated_amount × 100). Enables proportional comparison of budget performance across cost centers, input categories, and farm enterprises of different sizes.
reference: SAP S/4HANA CO; Granular Farm Management; GAAP

description: Unique surrogate identifier for each chemical compliance record in the procurement domain. Primary key for the chemical_compliance data product. Entity role: MASTER_RESOURCE — represents a regulatory compliance record for a procured crop protection chemical or biological input.
reference: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; EPA FIFRA Registration

description: Reference to the agrochemical product master record in the product domain. Links this compliance record to the specific crop protection chemical or biological input product being regulated.
reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; product.agrochemical_product

reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

description: Percentage concentration of the active ingredient (AI) in the formulated product, expressed as weight/weight (w/w) or weight/volume (w/v) percent. Used for dose calculation, MRL compliance, and SDS documentation.
reference: EPA FIFRA Label Requirements; FAO/WHO Codex Alimentarius

description: Common chemical name of the primary active ingredient (AI) responsible for the pesticidal action of the product, as listed on the EPA-approved label. Critical for MRL compliance checks and PHI determination.
reference: EPA FIFRA; Codex Alimentarius MRL Standards; ISO 1750 Pesticide Nomenclature

business_glossary_term: Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS) Import Permit Number
description: APHIS-issued permit number authorizing the importation of regulated biological inputs, biopesticides, or plant protection products. Required for cross-border procurement of biological agents under APHIS jurisdiction.

reference: EPA FIFRA; SAP S/4HANA QM Status Management

description: Unit of measure for the active ingredient concentration value (e.g., % w/w, % w/v, g/L). Ensures correct interpretation of concentration for compliance calculations.
reference: EPA FIFRA Label Requirements; ISO 1750

description: Timestamp when this chemical compliance record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements for OSHA HazCom, EPA regulatory reporting, and FSMA recordkeeping. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA QM or Oracle NetSuite document creation timestamp.

description: Disposal methods and instructions for the chemical product and its container as specified in SDS Section 13. Includes EPA waste classification, disposal facility requirements, and container rinsing procedures. Required for EPA RCRA compliance and environmental management.

description: 24-hour emergency telephone number for chemical emergency response, as listed on SDS Section 1 (e.g., CHEMTREC 1-800-424-9300). Required by OSHA HazCom and DOT hazardous materials regulations for emergency response coordination.

description: EPA-issued registration number for the pesticide product under the Federal Insecticide, Fungicide, and Rodenticide Act (FIFRA). Required for legal sale and use in the United States. Format: registrant-product[-supplemental].
reference: EPA FIFRA Section 3; 40 CFR Part 152

description: Summary of first aid instructions for exposure routes (inhalation, skin contact, eye contact, ingestion) as specified in SDS Section 4. Required for OSHA HazCom compliance and emergency response planning at field and warehouse locations.
reference: OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200 Appendix D Section 4; GHS Rev 9

description: Standardized formulation type code for the crop protection product (e.g., EC=Emulsifiable Concentrate, WP=Wettable Powder, SC=Suspension Concentrate, WG=Water Dispersible Granule, GR=Granule, SL=Soluble Liquid). Used for application equipment selection, mixing instructions, and storage classification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EC|WP|SC|WG|GR|SL|EW|CS|DP|UL|SP|ZC — promote to reference product]
reference: FAO/WHO Pesticide Specifications; CropLife International Formulation Codes

business_glossary_term: Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) Certification Applicability Flag
description: Indicates whether this chemical compliance record is subject to GAP certification requirements, including GLOBALG.A.P. IFA or equivalent scheme. When true, the chemical's use must be documented in the farm's GAP compliance records and subject to third-party audit.
reference: GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard v6; USDA GAP/GHP Audit Program

description: GHS hazard classification category for the chemical product, identifying the type and severity of physical, health, and environmental hazards (e.g., 'Acute Toxicity Category 3', 'Flammable Liquid Category 2'). Drives PPE requirements, storage segregation, and emergency response planning.
reference: GHS (Globally Harmonized System) Rev 9; OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200; UN GHS Purple Book

business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point (HACCP) Critical Control Point Flag
description: Indicates whether this chemical input is identified as a critical control point (CCP) in the facility's HACCP plan. When true, mandatory monitoring, corrective action, and verification procedures apply per Codex Alimentarius HACCP principles and FSMA Preventive Controls.
reference: Codex Alimentarius HACCP Guidelines CAC/RCP 1-1969; FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; FDA

description: Standardized GHS H-code hazard statements describing the nature and degree of hazards posed by the chemical (e.g., 'H301: Toxic if swallowed; H400: Very toxic to aquatic life'). Stored as a semicolon-delimited list of H-codes and descriptions. Required on SDS Section 2.
reference: GHS Rev 9 Annex 3; OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200 Appendix C

business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Preventive Controls Applicability Flag
description: Indicates whether this chemical input is subject to FSMA preventive controls requirements, triggering mandatory hazard analysis, preventive control measures, monitoring, corrective actions, and recordkeeping under the FSMA Preventive Controls for Human Food rule.
reference: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; FDA Food Safety Modernization Act

description: Indicates whether the biological input contains or is derived from genetically modified organisms (GMO). Required for APHIS biotechnology regulatory compliance, COOL labeling, and organic certification exclusion under USDA National Organic Program (NOP).
reference: USDA APHIS 7 CFR Part 340; USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205; EU GMO Regulation 1829/2003

description: Indicates whether the product is classified as a Restricted Use Pesticide (RUP) by the EPA, requiring purchase and use only by certified applicators or persons under their direct supervision. Critical for procurement authorization and applicator certification tracking.
reference: EPA FIFRA Section 3(d); 40 CFR Part 152 Subpart I

description: Indicates whether the product label has been reviewed and confirmed to comply with all applicable EPA label requirements, including use directions, safety precautions, PHI, REI, and first aid statements. Required for GAP certification and HACCP compliance documentation.
reference: EPA FIFRA Section 2(p); GLOBALG.A.P. IFA; HACCP Codex Alimentarius

description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this chemical compliance record. Tracks changes to SDS revisions, registration status updates, MRL changes, or label amendments. Required for regulatory audit trail and change management.
reference: OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200(g)(5); FSMA; SOX

description: The specific agricultural commodity (e.g., corn grain, soybean, wheat) for which the MRL value applies. MRL values are commodity-specific and market-specific, requiring separate records per commodity-market combination.
reference: Codex Alimentarius; EPA 40 CFR Part 180; USDA AMS

description: The regulatory jurisdiction or export market for which the MRL value applies (e.g., USA, EU, Japan, China). Different markets have different MRL standards; this field enables multi-market compliance tracking.
reference: Codex Alimentarius; EU Regulation 396/2005; USDA FAS Export Requirements

description: Maximum Residue Limit (MRL) for the active ingredient on the target commodity, expressed in mg/kg (ppm). Represents the highest legally permissible concentration of pesticide residue in or on food and feed commodities. Used for export market compliance and FSMA preventive controls.
reference: Codex Alimentarius MRL Standards; EPA 40 CFR Part 180; EU Regulation 396/2005

description: Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) in days — the minimum number of days that must elapse between the last application of the chemical and the harvest of the crop. Mandatory for GAP compliance and FSMA preventive controls to ensure MRL compliance at harvest.
reference: EPA FIFRA Label Requirements; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA; FSMA Produce Safety Rule 21 CFR Part 112

description: Required personal protective equipment (PPE) for handling, mixing, loading, and applying the chemical product as specified on the EPA label and SDS Section 8. Includes gloves, respirator type, eye protection, and protective clothing specifications. Mandatory for EPA Worker Protection Standard compliance.
reference: EPA Worker Protection Standard 40 CFR Part 170; OSHA PPE Standard 29 CFR 1910.132; SDS Section 8

description: Standardized GHS P-code precautionary statements describing recommended measures to minimize or prevent adverse effects from exposure, storage, or disposal (e.g., 'P260: Do not breathe dust/fume; P501: Dispose of contents in accordance with local regulations'). Stored as semicolon-delimited P-codes.
reference: GHS Rev 9 Annex 4; OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200 Appendix C

description: Classification of the crop protection product by its primary mode of action or target pest category. Drives regulatory pathway, label requirements, and IPM program classification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: herbicide|insecticide|fungicide|rodenticide|biopesticide|plant_growth_regulator|adjuvant|nematicide|bactericide — promote to reference product]
reference: EPA FIFRA; USDA NASS Pesticide Use Survey; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA

description: Date on which the EPA registration for this chemical product became effective. Marks the start of the legally authorized period for sale and use of the product in the United States under FIFRA.
reference: EPA FIFRA Section 3; 40 CFR Part 152

description: Date on which the EPA registration for this chemical product expires or is due for renewal. Null for registrations without a fixed expiry. Triggers procurement hold and re-registration workflow when approaching expiry.
reference: EPA FIFRA Section 3(g); 40 CFR Part 152

description: Restricted Entry Interval (REI) in hours — the minimum time that must pass after a pesticide application before workers may re-enter the treated area without personal protective equipment (PPE). Required for OSHA HazCom and EPA Worker Protection Standard compliance.
reference: EPA Worker Protection Standard 40 CFR Part 170; OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200

description: Unique document control number assigned to the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) for this chemical product. Used for document management, OSHA HazCom compliance, and audit trail. Corresponds to the SDS document identifier in the supplier's document management system.
reference: OSHA HazCom Standard 29 CFR 1910.1200; GHS (Globally Harmonized System) Rev 9

business_glossary_term: Safety Data Sheet (SDS) Expiry / Review Date
description: Date by which the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) must be reviewed and reissued or confirmed current. Typically set 3-5 years from the revision date per industry practice. Triggers SDS renewal workflow to maintain OSHA HazCom compliance.
reference: OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200; ANSI Z400.1

description: Date of the most recent revision of the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) as issued by the chemical manufacturer or supplier. OSHA requires SDS to be updated within 3 months of new hazard information. Critical for ensuring workers have access to current hazard information.
reference: OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200(g)(5); GHS Rev 9 Section 1

description: GHS/EPA signal word appearing on the product label and SDS indicating the relative level of hazard severity: DANGER (most severe), WARNING (moderate), CAUTION (least severe), or none for non-hazardous products. Required on SDS Section 2 and product label.
reference: GHS Rev 9 Section 1.4; EPA FIFRA Label Requirements; OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200

description: Two-letter US state code (USPS abbreviation) for which the state_registration_status applies. Enables state-by-state compliance tracking for pesticide products that require individual state registrations under FIFRA Section 24(c).
reference: EPA FIFRA Section 24(c); USPS State Abbreviations

description: Registration status of the pesticide product in the specific state(s) where it will be used. States may impose additional registration requirements beyond federal EPA registration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: registered|not_registered|pending|cancelled|restricted — promote to reference product if multi-state tracking is required]
reference: EPA FIFRA Section 24(c); State Lead Agency Pesticide Regulations

description: Storage conditions and requirements for the chemical product as specified in SDS Section 7, including temperature range, humidity, segregation from incompatible materials, ventilation, and container requirements. Used for warehouse storage planning and EPA/OSHA compliance.
reference: OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200 Appendix D Section 7; EPA FIFRA; NFPA 30

description: Unique surrogate identifier for each agricultural input record in the master catalog. Primary key for the input_catalog data product in the procurement domain.
reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master

reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link
