description: ACA employer mandate eligibility determination for this employee. 'Eligible' indicates the employee is a full-time employee (30+ hours/week average) subject to the ACA employer mandate. Used for Form 1095-C preparation and IRS ACA reporting.
reference: ACA (IRC §4980H); IRS Form 1095-C Instructions; Treasury Reg. §54.4980H

business_glossary_term: ACA Offer of Coverage Code (Form 1095-C Line 14)
description: IRS-defined code indicating the type of health coverage offered to the employee for each month, as reported on Form 1095-C Line 14 (e.g., '1A' = minimum essential coverage offered to employee and dependents at or below federal poverty line safe harbor). Required for ACA employer mandate reporting.
reference: IRS Form 1095-C; IRC §4980H; Treasury Reg. §54.4980H-6

description: IRS-defined code for the applicable Section 4980H safe harbor or other relief used by the employer, as reported on Form 1095-C Line 16 (e.g., '2C' = employee enrolled in coverage, '2D' = employee in limited non-assessment period). Required for ACA employer mandate reporting.
reference: IRS Form 1095-C; IRC §4980H; Treasury Reg. §54.4980H

description: Annualized employee premium cost for this benefit plan, calculated as employee_contribution_amount multiplied by the number of pay periods per year. Used for ACA affordability determination (employee-only coverage must not exceed 9.12% of household income) and total compensation statements.
reference: ACA (IRC §4980H); IRS Rev. Proc. 2023-29; ERISA

description: Average weekly hours worked by the employee during the ACA lookback measurement period. Used to determine full-time status (30+ hours/week threshold) for ACA employer mandate compliance and seasonal worker benefit eligibility.
reference: IRS Notice 2012-58; Treasury Reg. §54.4980H-3; ACA (IRC §4980H)

description: Unique code identifying the insurance carrier or benefit provider administering this plan (e.g., 'BCBS', 'AETNA', 'FIDELITY'). Used for EDI 834 benefit enrollment file transmission to carriers.
reference: HIPAA EDI 834 Transaction Set; SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Administration

description: Full legal name of the insurance carrier or benefit provider (e.g., 'Blue Cross Blue Shield of Illinois', 'Aetna Life Insurance Company'). Used in employee benefit communications, Summary Plan Descriptions (SPDs), and carrier invoicing.
reference: ERISA §102 (Summary Plan Description); HIPAA

description: Indicates whether the employee or qualified beneficiary has elected COBRA continuation coverage following termination of employment or other qualifying event. True when COBRA has been elected within the election period.
reference: COBRA (29 USC §1161-1168); DOL COBRA Regulations (29 CFR Part 2590)

description: The deadline by which the qualified beneficiary must elect COBRA continuation coverage following a qualifying event (typically 60 days from the later of coverage loss date or COBRA notice date). Populated when enrollment_status transitions to 'terminated'.
reference: COBRA (29 USC §1161-1168); DOL COBRA Regulations (29 CFR Part 2590)

description: Pay period frequency at which employee and employer contributions are applied (e.g., biweekly, semimonthly). Aligns with payroll cycle and is used to annualize contributions for ACA affordability safe harbor calculations.
reference: IRS Publication 15; ACA (IRC §4980H); SAP SuccessFactors Payroll

description: Indicates whether the employee's benefits are administered through an agricultural cooperative benefit pool arrangement rather than a direct employer plan. Cooperative pools are common in the agriculture industry for smaller farm operations to achieve group purchasing power.
reference: ERISA; Agricultural Cooperative Benefit Pool Agreements; USDA Rural Development

description: Level of coverage selected by the employee indicating who is covered under the plan: employee only, employee plus spouse, employee plus children, or full family. Determines premium amounts and ACA dependent coverage obligations.
reference: ACA (IRC §4980H); SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Administration

description: Timestamp when the benefit enrollment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance record retention.
reference: ERISA Record Retention Requirements; SOX; SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Administration

description: Number of dependents (spouse, children, or other qualifying dependents) covered under this enrollment. Used for coverage tier validation, ACA dependent coverage tracking (up to age 26), and premium calculation.
reference: ACA §1001 (dependent coverage to age 26); IRS Publication 501; ERISA

description: The date on which benefit coverage becomes active for the employee. May differ from enrollment date due to waiting periods, open enrollment cycles, or qualifying life events. Critical for ACA employer mandate compliance and payroll deduction start.
reference: ACA (IRC §4980H); ERISA; SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Administration

description: The per-pay-period dollar amount deducted from the employee's paycheck for this benefit plan. Used for payroll deduction processing, W-2 reporting, and total compensation analysis.
reference: IRS Publication 15; ERISA; SAP SuccessFactors Payroll Integration

description: The per-pay-period dollar amount contributed by the employer toward this benefit plan. Used for labor cost allocation across farm operations and processing facilities, COGS reporting, and ACA affordability determination.
reference: ACA (IRC §4980H); IRS Publication 15; ERISA; SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Administration

description: The date on which the employee completed and submitted the benefit enrollment election. Distinct from the effective date on which coverage begins. Used for open enrollment and qualifying life event tracking.
reference: ERISA; SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Administration

description: Current lifecycle status of the benefit enrollment record. 'Active' indicates current coverage; 'pending' indicates awaiting effective date or approval; 'terminated' indicates coverage has ended; 'waived' indicates employee opted out; 'cobra' indicates continuation coverage under COBRA; 'suspended' indicates temporary hold.
reference: ERISA; COBRA (29 USC §1161); ACA (IRC §4980H); SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Administration

description: The employer group policy or contract number assigned by the benefit carrier. Required for claims processing, carrier EDI transmissions, and employee insurance card issuance.
reference: HIPAA; ERISA; SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Administration

description: Indicates the type of H-2A mandated benefits provided to the employee under the H-2A temporary agricultural worker visa program. 'Housing' indicates employer-provided housing; 'meals' indicates employer-provided or subsidized meals; 'both' indicates both housing and meals are provided. 'Not applicable' for non-H-2A workers.
reference: H-2A Program Regulations (20 CFR Part 655); DOL Wage and Hour Division; USCIS H-2A Program

description: Fair market value of employer-provided housing per pay period for H-2A visa workers, as required to be tracked for DOL compliance and W-2 imputed income reporting. Used in H-2A housing and meals benefit compliance reporting.
reference: H-2A Program Regulations (20 CFR Part 655); IRS Publication 15-B (Fringe Benefits); DOL Wage and Hour Division

description: Timestamp when the benefit enrollment record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking, data synchronization with SAP SuccessFactors, and audit compliance.
reference: ERISA Record Retention Requirements; SOX; SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Administration

description: End date of the ACA measurement/lookback period used to determine full-time employee status for seasonal and variable-hour agricultural workers. Together with lookback_period_start_date, defines the window for average hours calculation.
reference: IRS Notice 2012-58; Treasury Reg. §54.4980H-3; ACA (IRC §4980H)

description: Start date of the ACA measurement/lookback period used to determine full-time employee status for seasonal and variable-hour agricultural workers. Critical for seasonal workforce benefit eligibility determination under the ACA look-back measurement method.
reference: IRS Notice 2012-58; Treasury Reg. §54.4980H-3; ACA (IRC §4980H)

description: Identifier for the annual open enrollment period during which this election was made (e.g., 'OE-2024', 'OE-2025'). Distinguishes open enrollment elections from qualifying life event mid-year changes.
reference: ERISA; SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Administration

description: Unique code identifying the specific benefit plan offered by the employer (e.g., MED-PPO-01, DENT-HMO-02, 401K-MATCH). Corresponds to the plan identifier in SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Administration.
reference: SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Administration; ACA Employer Mandate (IRC §4980H)

description: Human-readable name of the benefit plan (e.g., 'Blue Cross PPO Medical Plan', 'Delta Dental HMO', 'Fidelity 401(k) Retirement Plan'). Used in employee communications and ACA reporting.
reference: SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Administration; ERISA

description: Further classification of the benefit plan within its type (e.g., PPO, HMO, HDHP for medical; term or whole life for life insurance; traditional or Roth for 401(k)). Drives eligibility for HSA pairing and ACA minimum value determination. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PPO|HMO|EPO|HDHP|POS|term|whole_life|short_term_disability|long_term_disability|traditional|roth — promote to reference product]
reference: ACA (IRC §4980H); IRS Publication 969 (HSA/FSA); ERISA

description: Category of benefit plan enrolled. Covers standard benefits (medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability, 401(k), FSA, HSA) and agricultural worker-specific benefits (employer-provided housing allowance, transportation subsidy, H-2A mandated housing and meals provision, tool/equipment allowance). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: medical|dental|vision|life_insurance|disability|retirement_401k|fsa|hsa|housing_allowance|transportation_subsidy|h2a_housing|h2a_meals|equipment_allowance — promote to reference product]
reference: SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Administration; ACA (IRC §4980H); H-2A Program Regulations (20 CFR Part 655); ERISA

description: Date on which the qualifying life event occurred that triggered a mid-year enrollment change. Must be documented for ERISA special enrollment compliance. Null when enrollment_type is open enrollment.
reference: ERISA §701; ACA (IRC §9801)

description: Type of qualifying life event that triggered a mid-year benefit enrollment change outside of open enrollment. 'None' indicates a standard open enrollment election. Required for ERISA and ACA compliance documentation of special enrollment rights. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: marriage|divorce|birth|adoption|death|employment_change|loss_of_coverage|none — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
reference: ERISA §701; ACA (IRC §9801); IRS Notice 2014-55

description: External enrollment record identifier from SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Administration module. Used for system-of-record reconciliation and integration traceability.
reference: SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Administration

description: The date on which benefit coverage ends for the employee. Populated upon employment termination, voluntary waiver, plan year end without re-enrollment, or loss of eligibility. Triggers COBRA notification obligations.
reference: COBRA (29 USC §1161); ERISA; ACA (IRC §4980H); SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Administration

description: Reason provided by the employee for waiving (opting out of) a benefit plan. Required for ACA reporting when employee declines offered coverage. Null when enrollment_status is not 'waived'.
reference: ACA (IRC §4980H); IRS Form 1095-C; ERISA

description: Primary key for payroll

reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

description: Reference to the SAP CO cost center to which labor costs are allocated, enabling crop enterprise budget tracking and farm operation cost analysis.
reference: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; GAAP Cost Allocation Standards

description: Reference to the employee record for whom this payroll record is generated. Links to the workforce employee master.
reference: SAP SuccessFactors HR Module

reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Each payroll run generates a corresponding GL journal entry. Linking payroll records to journal entries enables payroll-to-GL reconciliation, audit trails for SOX compliance, and period-close verifica
reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

description: Foreign key linking to workforce.labor_contract. Business justification: Payroll records are generated under the terms of a labor contract (wage rate, AEWR compliance, H-2A guaranteed hours). Adding labor_contract_id normalizes the relationship and replaces the h2a_contrac
reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

business_glossary_term: Adverse Effect Wage Rate (AEWR) Compliance Flag
description: Indicates whether the effective hourly wage paid to the employee meets or exceeds the DOL Adverse Effect Wage Rate (AEWR) for the applicable state and period. Critical H-2A compliance indicator.
reference: DOL H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655.120; APHIS; DOL Wage and Hour Division

description: The DOL-published Adverse Effect Wage Rate applicable to the employee's state and job classification for the pay period. Used as the minimum wage floor for H-2A guest workers and compliance benchmarking.
reference: DOL H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655.120; USDA Farm Labor Survey

description: The date and time when this payroll record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports audit trail and SOX financial reporting controls.
reference: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; SAP SuccessFactors Audit Trail; GAAP

description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this payroll record. Typically USD for domestic operations; supports international agricultural operations.
reference: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS; GAAP

description: Classification of the employee's engagement type, distinguishing permanent staff, seasonal farm workers, H-2A guest workers, and migrant laborers. Drives compliance rule application and wage rate determination. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: permanent|seasonal|h2a_guest_worker|migrant|contract|part_time|temporary — promote to reference product]
reference: H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655; Migrant and Seasonal Agricultural Worker Protection Act (MSPA); DOL

description: Identifier for the specific farm operation or production unit (e.g., field, orchard, processing facility) where the employee worked. Enables labor cost allocation to crop enterprise budgets in Granular Farm Management.
reference: Granular Farm Management; SAP S/4HANA CO Module; USDA Farm Records

description: Amount of federal income tax withheld from the employee's gross wages for the pay period per IRS withholding tables and the employee's W-4 elections.
reference: IRS Publication 15 (Circular E); Internal Revenue Code Section 3402

description: Total pre-deduction earnings for the pay period, including regular pay, overtime premium, piece-rate earnings, and any other compensation components before tax and other deductions.
reference: DOL Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); IRS Publication 15; GAAP

description: The base hourly wage rate applied to this payroll record. For H-2A workers, must meet or exceed the Adverse Effect Wage Rate (AEWR) published by DOL for the applicable state and crop activity.
reference: DOL H-2A Adverse Effect Wage Rate (AEWR); Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); USDA

description: Amount deducted from gross wages for employer-provided housing furnished to H-2A workers or other agricultural employees. Must comply with DOL reasonable cost or fair rental value limits.
reference: DOL H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655.122(d); FLSA Section 3(m)

description: The DOL Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) or internal job code for the employee's role during the pay period (e.g., crop worker, equipment operator, agronomist). Drives AEWR rate selection and compliance rule application.
reference: DOL Standard Occupational Classification (SOC); H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655; USDA

description: The date and time when this payroll record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Required for data lineage, audit trail, and SOX compliance.
reference: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; SAP SuccessFactors Audit Trail; GAAP

description: Employee share of Medicare (HI) tax withheld under FICA for the pay period, including the Additional Medicare Tax for high earners where applicable.
reference: IRS Publication 15; Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA); Internal Revenue Code Section 3101

description: The actual take-home amount disbursed to the employee after all tax withholdings and authorized deductions are subtracted from gross wages.
reference: DOL Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); IRS Publication 15; GAAP

description: Total of all other authorized deductions not separately itemized (e.g., voluntary benefit elections, garnishments, tool deductions) applied to gross wages for the pay period.
reference: DOL Wage and Hour Division; IRS Publication 15; State Wage Payment Laws

description: Total overtime premium earnings for the pay period, calculated at 1.5x the regular rate for hours exceeding 40 per week per FLSA requirements.
reference: DOL Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Section 7; IRS Publication 15

description: Total overtime hours worked beyond the FLSA 40-hour weekly threshold during the pay period. Required for FLSA overtime premium pay calculation and DOL wage and hour compliance reporting.
reference: DOL Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Section 7

description: The frequency at which the employee is paid. Determines pay period boundaries and is critical for H-2A three-fourths guarantee calculations and FLSA overtime compliance.
reference: DOL Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655

description: The last calendar date of the payroll processing period. Defines the boundary for wage calculations, overtime determination, and H-2A three-fourths guarantee assessment.
reference: DOL Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655

description: The first calendar date of the payroll processing period. Used for DOL wage and hour compliance, H-2A three-fourths guarantee tracking, and labor cost allocation.
reference: DOL Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655

description: The compensation structure applied to this payroll record. Piece-rate is common for harvest operations; hourly applies to FLSA overtime calculations; salary for permanent staff.
reference: DOL Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655

description: The actual date on which wages were disbursed to the employee. Required for DOL wage payment timeliness compliance and state wage payment law adherence.
reference: DOL Wage and Hour Division; State Wage Payment Laws

description: The method by which net pay is disbursed to the employee. Direct deposit is standard; check and pay card are common for seasonal and H-2A workers without bank accounts.
reference: DOL Wage and Hour Division; State Wage Payment Laws; NACHA Operating Rules

description: Current workflow state of the payroll record within the SAP SuccessFactors payroll processing lifecycle, from initial calculation through final payment or reversal.
reference: SAP SuccessFactors Payroll Module; SOX Internal Controls

description: Total earnings derived from piece-rate compensation (harvest pay) for the pay period, calculated as piece_rate_units multiplied by piece_rate_per_unit. Supports harvest labor cost analysis.
reference: DOL Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655

description: The monetary rate paid per piece-rate unit (e.g., per bin, per pound, per row) for harvest or production work. Confidential compensation data used for piece-rate earnings calculation.
reference: DOL Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655

description: Total number of piece-rate units (e.g., bins picked, rows harvested, pounds collected) completed by the employee during the pay period. Drives piece-rate earnings calculation for harvest pay.
reference: DOL Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655

description: Total non-overtime hours worked by the employee during the pay period. Used for FLSA compliance, H-2A three-fourths guarantee tracking, and labor cost allocation to farm operations.
reference: DOL Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655

description: The payroll document reference number generated by SAP S/4HANA payroll processing, used for reconciliation and audit trail back to the system of record.
reference: SAP S/4HANA Payroll Module; SOX Financial Reporting Controls

description: Employee share of Social Security (OASDI) tax withheld under FICA for the pay period, calculated at the statutory rate on wages up to the annual wage base.
reference: IRS Publication 15; Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA); Internal Revenue Code Section 3101

description: Amount of state income tax withheld from the employee's gross wages for the pay period per applicable state tax authority withholding requirements.
reference: State Tax Authority Regulations; DOL Wage and Hour Division

description: The minimum number of hours the employer is obligated to offer the H-2A worker under the three-fourths guarantee provision (75% of contract period workdays). Used for compliance tracking and potential back-pay liability assessment.
reference: DOL H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655.122(i); DOL Wage and Hour Division

description: Indicates whether the employer has met the H-2A three-fourths guarantee obligation for this pay period. A False value triggers back-pay liability calculation for the shortfall hours.
reference: DOL H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655.122(i); DOL Wage and Hour Division

description: Amount deducted from gross wages for employer-provided transportation to/from the worksite. Subject to DOL H-2A regulations limiting deductions to actual cost and prohibiting deductions that reduce wages below AEWR.
reference: DOL H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655.122(h); FLSA Section 3(m)

description: Two-letter US state code where the employee performed work during the pay period. Determines applicable state income tax withholding, state minimum wage, and H-2A AEWR rate.
reference: DOL H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655; State Tax Authority Regulations; USDA

description: Unique system-generated identifier for each employee leave request record. Primary key for the leave_request data product in the workforce domain.
reference: SAP SuccessFactors Absence Management

description: Foreign key linking to workforce.labor_contract. Business justification: Leave requests for H-2A workers have direct contract implications (h2a_contract_impact flag, h2a_early_departure_date). Linking leave_request to labor_contract enables automated contract compliance ch
reference: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

description: Reference to the position held by the employee at the time of the leave request. Used for labor scheduling impact analysis during critical planting and harvest windows.
reference: SAP SuccessFactors HR Module

description: Reference to the employee submitting the leave request. Links to the workforce.employee master record.
reference: SAP SuccessFactors HR Module

description: Current workflow state of the leave request. Tracks the full lifecycle from initial submission through final disposition. 'under_review' indicates HR or legal review is in progress (common for FMLA eligibility determinations).
reference: SAP SuccessFactors Absence Management; FMLA 29 CFR Part 825

description: Total number of calendar or working days officially approved. May differ from requested_days if the supervisor partially approves the leave. Used for payroll deduction calculations and FMLA entitlement balance updates.
reference: FMLA 29 CFR Part 825; SAP SuccessFactors Absence Management

description: The officially approved end date of the leave as confirmed by the supervisor or HR. Used for payroll processing, scheduling, and FMLA entitlement tracking. Null if leave has not yet been approved.
reference: SAP SuccessFactors Absence Management; FMLA 29 CFR Part 825

description: The officially approved start date of the leave as confirmed by the supervisor or HR. Used for payroll processing, scheduling, and FMLA entitlement tracking. Null if leave has not yet been approved.
reference: SAP SuccessFactors Absence Management; FMLA 29 CFR Part 825

description: The expiration date of the supporting medical or other certification on file for this leave request. FMLA certifications are valid for the duration of the condition, up to 12 months. Triggers recertification workflow when approaching expiry.
reference: FMLA 29 CFR Part 825.308; DOL WH-380

description: Indicates whether the required supporting certification documentation has been received (e.g., DOL WH-380 medical certification for FMLA, military orders for military leave, jury summons for jury duty). True = certification on file.
reference: FMLA 29 CFR Part 825.305; DOL WH-380; USERRA

description: System audit timestamp recording when the leave request record was first created in the data platform. Supports data lineage and Silver layer audit requirements.
reference: SOX; GDPR Article 5(2); SAP SuccessFactors Absence Management

description: The date and time the supervisor or HR rendered a final approval or denial decision on the leave request. FMLA requires written notice within 5 business days of the eligibility determination (29 CFR 825.300).
reference: FMLA 29 CFR Part 825.300; SAP SuccessFactors Absence Management

description: Narrative explanation provided by the supervisor or HR when a leave request is denied or partially denied. Required for FMLA denial notices (29 CFR 825.300) and supports employee grievance and appeal processes. Null when approval_status is not 'denied'.
reference: FMLA 29 CFR Part 825.300; DOL Wage and Hour Division

business_glossary_term: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Eligibility Flag
description: Indicates whether the employee meets FMLA eligibility criteria at the time of the request: 12 months of employment and 1,250 hours worked in the preceding 12-month lookback period at a covered employer location (50+ employees within 75 miles). True = eligible; False = not eligible.
reference: FMLA 29 CFR Part 825.110; DOL Wage and Hour Division

business_glossary_term: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Entitlement Used Days
description: Cumulative FMLA leave days consumed by the employee in the current 12-month FMLA measurement period prior to this request. The FMLA entitlement is 12 weeks (84 calendar days) per year; military caregiver leave allows up to 26 weeks.
reference: FMLA 29 CFR Part 825.200; DOL Wage and Hour Division

business_glossary_term: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Hours Worked Lookback
description: Total hours worked by the employee in the 12-month period immediately preceding the leave request date, used to determine FMLA eligibility (threshold: 1,250 hours). Sourced from SAP SuccessFactors time and attendance records.
reference: FMLA 29 CFR Part 825.110; DOL Wage and Hour Division

description: Indicates whether this leave request involves an H-2A visa worker and may impact the three-fourths guarantee calculation (the employer's obligation to offer at least 75% of the contracted work hours). True = H-2A contract obligations are affected by this leave.
reference: USDA H-2A Program; 20 CFR Part 655 Subpart B; DOL Wage and Hour Division

description: For H-2A visa workers requesting early departure before contract completion, the date the worker intends to depart. Used to calculate the impact on the three-fourths guarantee and to initiate contract completion documentation with APHIS/DOL.
reference: USDA H-2A Program; 20 CFR Part 655.122; APHIS

description: Indicates whether the requested leave dates fall within a designated harvest-critical or planting-critical operational window where discretionary leave approvals may be restricted due to operational necessity. Populated from the farm operations calendar. True = leave overlaps a critical window.
reference: USDA Farm Labor Standards; Granular Farm Management; SAP SuccessFactors Absence Management

description: Describes the expected frequency and duration of intermittent leave episodes as certified by a healthcare provider (e.g., '2 episodes per month, 1-3 days each'). Required for scheduling and FMLA certification documentation when is_intermittent = True.
reference: FMLA 29 CFR Part 825.306; DOL WH-380 Certification Form

description: Indicates whether the leave is taken intermittently or on a reduced schedule rather than as a continuous block. Common for chronic conditions under FMLA. True = intermittent/reduced schedule; False = continuous leave block.
reference: FMLA 29 CFR Part 825.202; SAP SuccessFactors Absence Management

description: System audit timestamp recording the most recent update to the leave request record. Tracks amendments, status changes, and date modifications throughout the leave lifecycle.
reference: SOX; GDPR Article 5(2); SAP SuccessFactors Absence Management

description: Narrative or coded reason provided by the employee for the leave request (e.g., serious health condition, childbirth, family care, military deployment, bereavement). Treated as confidential HR data. For FMLA leaves, this field supports the qualifying reason determination per 29 CFR Part 825.
reference: FMLA 29 CFR Part 825; GDPR Article 9 (special category data); SAP SuccessFactors Absence Management

description: Classification of the leave request by policy category. Covers FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act), state-mandated paid sick leave, personal leave, vacation/PTO (Paid Time Off), bereavement, jury duty, military leave, H-2A early departure, and agricultural seasonal layoff. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FMLA|paid_sick|personal|vacation_pto|bereavement|jury_duty|military|h2a_early_departure|seasonal_layoff — promote to reference product]
reference: FMLA 29 CFR Part 825; USDA H-2A Program; SAP SuccessFactors Absence Management

description: Indicates whether the required fitness-for-duty or medical clearance documentation has been received from the employee prior to return to work. True = clearance documentation received and on file.
reference: FMLA 29 CFR Part 825.312; SAP SuccessFactors Absence Management

description: Indicates whether the employee must provide a fitness-for-duty certification from a healthcare provider before returning to work. Applicable for FMLA medical leaves and roles with physical demands (e.g., pesticide applicators, equipment operators). True = clearance required.
reference: FMLA 29 CFR Part 825.312; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.134

description: Free-text field for HR or supervisor comments, special accommodations, or additional context related to the leave request. May include ADA accommodation notes or operational coverage arrangements. Treated as confidential HR data.
reference: ADA 42 U.S.C. § 12101; GDPR Article 9; SAP SuccessFactors Absence Management

description: Indicates the payroll treatment for the approved leave period. Determines whether the employee receives full pay, no pay, partial pay, state-mandated paid leave benefits, or short-term disability benefits during the absence. Drives payroll processing in SAP S/4HANA Payroll.
reference: SAP S/4HANA Payroll; SAP SuccessFactors Absence Management; FSMA; State Paid Sick Leave Laws

description: Human-readable, externally referenceable business identifier for the leave request (e.g., LR-2024-000123). Used in employee communications, HR correspondence, and compliance documentation.
reference: SAP SuccessFactors Absence Management

description: Total number of calendar or working days requested by the employee, as submitted. Supports FMLA 12-week entitlement tracking and H-2A three-fourths guarantee calculations. Decimal to accommodate partial-day requests.
reference: FMLA 29 CFR Part 825; USDA H-2A Program

description: The date the employee requested their leave to end, as submitted in the original leave request. May differ from the approved end date.
reference: SAP SuccessFactors Absence Management; FMLA 29 CFR Part 825

description: The date the employee requested their leave to begin, as submitted in the original leave request. May differ from the approved start date if the supervisor modifies the leave window.
reference: SAP SuccessFactors Absence Management; FMLA 29 CFR Part 825

description: The actual or expected date the employee is scheduled to return to active duty following the leave. Critical for labor scheduling during planting and harvest windows. May be updated if leave is extended.
reference: SAP SuccessFactors Absence Management; FMLA 29 CFR Part 825.312

description: For seasonal agricultural workers on planned layoff, the anticipated rehire or recall date for the next growing season. Supports seasonal workforce availability forecasting and rehire eligibility tracking in SAP SuccessFactors.
reference: USDA Farm Labor Standards; SAP SuccessFactors Workforce Planning; Granular Farm Management

description: The date and time the employee formally submitted the leave request in the system. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for the transaction lifecycle. Used to measure HR response time KPIs and FMLA notice compliance (29 CFR 825.302).
reference: SAP SuccessFactors Absence Management; FMLA 29 CFR Part 825.302

description: The native absence record identifier from SAP SuccessFactors Absence Management module. Enables bidirectional reconciliation between the Databricks Silver layer and the system of record for HR audit and payroll integration.
reference: SAP SuccessFactors Absence Management
